title: Targeting neuroblastoma with 3beta,5alpha-tetrahydrocorticosterone: Activation of aryl hydrocarbon receptor inhibits tumor growth, metastasis, and stemness while promoting neural differentiation.
authors: Wen, Zhu-Qian; Hsu, Wen-Ming; Chiou, Chien-Chun; Maulana, Farhan Azhwin; Chang, Chia-Hwa; Huang, Jie-Ming; Yu, Zhi-Kai; Chen, Chien-Chin; Lin, Neng-Yu; Tsai, Chun-Fa; Lai, Jheng-Siou; Chen, Yue-Ling; Wu, Pei-Yi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子3beta-THB激活AHR受体抑制神经母细胞瘤，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Neuroblastoma (NB) is a highly malignant pediatric cancer that originates from the sympathoadrenal lineage of the neural crest. Recent studies have suggested the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AHR) pathway as a promising therapeutic target for NB. In this study, we investigated the therapeutic potential of 3beta,5alpha-Tetrahydrocorticosterone (3beta-THB) for NB by activating AHR signaling. By means of homology modeling and docking simulations, we demonstrated that 3beta-THB binds strongly to the PAS-B domain of human AHR. Experimental validation further confirmed that 3beta-THB promotes the nuclear translocation of AHR and upregulates AHR downstream gene CYP1A1 in NB cells, suggesting the AHR agonist role of 3beta-THB. In vitro evaluation of its efficacy demonstrated that 3beta-THB significantly inhibited NB cell proliferation, promoted neural differentiation, and induced cell cycle arrest at the G0/G1 phase. Additionally, 3beta-THB treatment increased apoptosis, reduced metastatic potential, and suppressed tumorsphere growth in NB cells. The expression of the NB oncogenic driver MYCN and markers associated with stemness was also inhibited by 3beta-THB. In vivo, 3beta-THB significantly suppressed tumor growth in both xenograft and TH-MYCN transgenic mouse models, with improved survival rates and minimal liver or kidney toxicity. These findings underscore the potential of 3beta-THB as a powerful AHR agonist for treating neuroblastoma.
abstract_zh: 神经母细胞瘤（Neuroblastoma, NB）是一种源自神经嵴交感肾上腺谱系的高度恶性儿童癌症。近期研究表明，芳基烃受体（aryl hydrocarbon receptor, AHR）通路是NB的一个有前景的治疗靶点。在本研究中，我们通过激活AHR信号传导，探讨了3beta,5alpha-四氢皮质酮（3beta-THB）对NB的治疗潜力。通过同源建模和对接模拟，我们证明3beta-THB能强效结合于人AHR的PAS-B结构域。实验验证进一步确认，3beta-THB促进AHR的核转位，并在NB细胞中上调AHR下游基因CYP1A1，表明3beta-THB具有AHR激动剂作用。对其疗效的体外评估显示，3beta-THB显著抑制NB细胞增殖，促进神经分化，并诱导细胞周期阻滞于G0/G1期。此外，3beta-THB处理增加了细胞凋亡，降低了转移潜能，并抑制了NB细胞中的肿瘤球生长。NB致癌驱动因子MYCN及与干性相关标志物的表达也受到3beta-THB的抑制。在体内实验中，3beta-THB在异种移植和TH-MYCN转基因小鼠模型中均显著抑制肿瘤生长，提高了生存率，且对肝脏或肾脏毒性极小。这些发现强调了3beta-THB作为强效AHR激动剂治疗神经母细胞瘤的潜力。
